decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.2 oz/h. It goes to N600-09, the richest stope (11.9 g/t, 239 t). LH410 loads there at 25.4 t/h, worth about 9.7 oz/h. It arrives at about 10:10. That gives roughly 160 t, or 61 oz, minus about 1.4 oz of development loss. LH-09 stays put because its critical heading costs 4 oz/h, and LH-05 should be repaired by about 11:30, so covering E543-11 gains little. LH-10 is not available until 11:00, and a second loader would add little at Norte, where the trucks are the limit.
